title: A functional approach reveals cross-system bottom-up control on coral reefs
content:
by Sterling B. Tebbett, Scott D. Ling

Understanding how cross-system subsidies shape the functioning of recipient ecosystems across trophic levels was unresolved. A new study in PLOS Biology reveals seabird-derived nutrients fuel primary producers on coral reefs, enhancing herbivore productivity.
